KUBECONFIG.description: The kubeconfig of the cluster, as for any kubectl command. Default: kubectl's own (~/.kube/config). The cluster needs agent-sandbox with its extensions.

OSF_SANDBOX_NAMESPACE.description: The namespace of the sandboxes, their egress pods and their Secrets. Give sandboxes a namespace of their own.

OSF_SECRETS_DIR.description: Folder of the secret files: ref:file/<name> in a sandbox spec is the file <name> in it. kubectl puts each into a Secret that only the sandbox's egress pod mounts; the adapter never reads it.

OSF_SECRET_*.description: OSF_SECRET_<NAME> holds the value of ref:env/<NAME> in a sandbox spec. It goes into a Secret that only the sandbox's egress pod gets, as its variable <NAME>.

OSF_OPENBAO_ADDR.description: OpenBao's address for ref:openbao/<path>, as the egress pod reaches it. Needed only for such secrets.

OSF_OPENBAO_TOKEN.description: The token the egress proxy reads OpenBao with. The sandbox never gets it.

OSF_OPENBAO_MOUNT.description: The KV v2 mount of ref:openbao/<path>: the secret's field value at <mount>/data/<path>.

OSF_SANDBOX_HOST_ALIASES.description: Hostnames the egress pod resolves to fixed addresses, as host=ip pairs separated by commas, such as host.docker.internal=172.18.0.1 on kind.

OSF_SANDBOX_SNAPSHOT_SIZE.description: The size of the PersistentVolumeClaim that snapshot copies /workspace into.
